figurative_meaning_en: falling into deep water; falling into trouble
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিদেশে এসে আমি জলে পড়েছি, কোনো পরিচিত মানুষ নেই।
এই চাকরিতে নেওয়ার পর থেকে সে জলে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Coming to a foreign country, I fell into water; I have no acquaintances here.
Since taking this job, he has fallen into water.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of drowning or struggling in water, common in Bengali folklore for depicting peril.
